All cases work correctly:
1. Scalar `x` with `keep_attrs=True` no longer crashes — returns empty attrs (since a scalar has none)
2. DataArray `x` with `keep_attrs=True` still propagates attrs from `x`
3. Default behavior (no `keep_attrs`) still returns empty attrs

The fix checks whether `x` has an `attrs` attribute before trying to index into the filtered attrs list. When `x` is a scalar (no `.attrs`), the lambda returns an empty dict instead of trying `attrs[1]` which would be out of range.
